Track repository star growth over time without exposing stargazer identities; useful for measuring project reach alongside scientific milestones.
Split long provenance/security changes into smaller reviewable stacks while keeping them coordinated; especially useful when separate evidence, workflow, and security changes need independent review.
Useful later for agent-driven PR orchestration and merge-queue automation; not required for the current audit path.

Verify secret scanning and user/repository push protection in the public repository.
